name: @qeetrix/ui
description: Qeet Group design system — accessible, token-driven React components (Base UI + Tailwind v4).

components.name: AccessReview
components.description: Product-neutral access surface for identity and security consoles, in two modes: - **Assignment** (default): each row's checkbox is the grant itself, and `onStateChange` emits grant / deny intent.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: A stack of sections whose headers show and hide their panels.

components.name: ActionBar
components.description: The bulk-selection bar: floats above the page while rows are selected.

variant.note: ActionBarItem.variant is passed straight to Button's variant, so Button's cva is the definition: default | destructive | outline | ghost.

size.note: ActionBarItem.size is passed straight to Button's size.

components.name: Alert
components.description: An inline, assertive status message (`role="alert"`).

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: An alert dialog interrupts to ask for a decision, so it is dismissed by a decision.

components.name: AngleSlider
components.description: Circular slider for selecting a 0–360° angle (APG Slider).

size.note: A pixel diameter for the dial, not a closed set of appearances.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: A minimal full-height application frame: a flex row for an optional sidebar beside a main column.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.description: Constrains its content to a fixed width-to-height ratio using the native CSS `aspect-ratio` property.

components.name: AuditEvent
components.description: Typed, product-neutral audit-event anatomy.

severity.note: Mapped through SEVERITY_KIND onto StatusPill's kind, which maps onto Badge's variant. The value set is the AuditSeverity domain vocabulary.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Free-text input with advisory suggestions — APG Combobox, the "no required selection" variant.

components.name: AvailabilityGrid
components.description: Week × time-slot picker (booking availability, shift planning).

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A person's picture, initials or a neutral icon.

size.note: Written to data-size and styled with data-[size=…] utilities: xs | sm | default | lg | xl.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small label for a count, a status or a category: one solid Qeet fill for emphasis, quiet tints for the brand and status tones, and neutral styles for everything else.

components.name: Banner
components.description: App-wide announcement bar (maintenance notices, plan limits, new features).

components.name: Blockquote
components.description: Standalone pull-quote / testimonial — distinct from `Prose`-styled blockquotes.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: The breadcrumb landmark.

components.name: Button
components.description: The Qeet action control: one primary action per view, with secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link variants, icon-only sizes, and a `loading` state that keeps focus.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: A group of connected buttons with merged interior border-radius.

orientation.note: Structural: horizontal or vertical stacking, written to data-orientation. Not an appearance axis.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Calendar — the canonical shadcn Calendar (react-day-picker v9), restyled for Qeet.

components.name: Callout
components.description: Inline informational box with a coloured inline-start accent.

components.name: Card
components.description: A surface that groups related content, with an optional header (title, description and an action slot), content and footer, in default, outline and elevated styles.

size.note: Written to data-size and styled with data-[size=sm] utilities: default | sm.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Accessible carousel built on Embla.

orientation.note: Structural: sets Embla's scroll axis and swaps the inline/block spacing utilities. Not an appearance axis.

components.name: Chart
components.description: Chart containers built on Recharts and themed with the Qeetrix series colours, with `ChartDataTable` as the non-colour alternative every chart should offer.

components.name: ChartPresets
components.description: Ready-made area, bar, line and donut charts with Qeetrix defaults.

tone.note: Sparkline.tone selects a stroke colour from a map: default | positive | negative | neutral.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: The Qeet selection control, square.

components.name: CheckboxCard
components.description: A checkbox with room for a title and a description — a choice that needs explaining, not a promotional tile.

components.name: Chip
components.description: A selectable pill for filters and choices.

components.name: Clipboard
components.description: Copy to the clipboard: `CopyButton`, which confirms the copy, and the `useCopyToClipboard` hook.

components.name: CloseButton
components.description: Standalone dismiss/close button.

size.note: Passed straight to Button's size, restricted to the icon sizes: icon-xs | icon-sm | icon.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: CodeBlock renders a copyable, optionally syntax-highlighted code block.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: A single section that shows and hides its content.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.description: ColorPicker consolidates the (clickable-swatch + hex-text + native picker) combo into one primitive.

components.name: ColorSwatch
components.description: A colour sample that can be selected.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Single-select with type-to-filter: APG Combobox, list autocomplete.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: CommandPalette is a Cmd-K modal: a centered search box with a filtered, grouped list of navigable items.

components.name: CommentThread
components.description: Threaded comments for review, approval and incident workflows: avatars, relative timestamps, an "edited" marker, reactions, replies, edit and delete, and a composer.

components.name: Container
components.description: Centered responsive content shell.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click or long-press, with the same item types as `DropdownMenu`.

variant.note: ContextMenuItem writes data-variant and styles with data-[variant=destructive]: default | destructive.

components.name: CopyableSecret
components.description: CopyableSecret renders a read-only code box next to a Copy button.

size.note: Selects padding and text-size utilities in a conditional, and forwards a mapped value to Button: sm | md.

components.name: CountryPicker
components.description: CountryPicker: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes with localised names from `Intl.DisplayNames`.

components.name: CurrencyInput
components.description: Numeric amount entry with a locale-aware currency symbol.

components.name: DataState
components.description: DataState collapses the four common render branches of a query-backed surface — loading / error / empty / data — into one component.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: DataTable wraps TanStack Table over the qeetrix Table primitives.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: A single-date picker: a field-styled trigger opening a Calendar in a Popover.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.description: Date + time-of-day picker: a Calendar with a TimePicker footer inside a Popover, emitting a single `Date`.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.description: Key-value detail view for entity/settings pages.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A modal window over the page for a focused task.

exceptions.focus: Focus containment is enforced with `inert`, which jsdom does not implement, so the tests assert the mechanism is installed rather than observing containment. Browser-level verification is on the manual checklist.

components.name: DiffViewer
components.description: Read-only text/JSON diff (config history, file versions, audit).

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Drawer is the mobile bottom sheet: anchored to the bottom edge, rounded on top, and dismissed by swiping it down as well as by Escape, the close button or the backdrop.

exceptions.focus: Focus containment is enforced with `inert`, which jsdom does not implement, so the tests assert the mechanism is installed rather than observing containment. Browser-level verification is on the manual checklist.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a trigger, with groups, labels, checkbox and radio items, keyboard shortcuts and submenus.

variant.note: DropdownMenuItem writes data-variant and styles with data-[variant=destructive]: default | destructive.

components.name: Editable
components.description: Text that edits in place: the preview becomes an input, Enter or leaving the field saves, and Escape cancels.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: EmptyState is the icon + title + description + action zero-state used for empty lists, no-results, no-permission, failed-load and first-run surfaces.

components.name: Feed
components.description: APG Feed pattern: an `aria-live` scrollable list of articles (activity streams, audit timelines, notification feeds).

variant.note: Written to data-variant: card | list. AuditLog forwards the same prop.

components.name: Field
components.description: Groups a form control with its label, description and validation message, and wires them together for assistive technology.

variant.note: FieldLegend writes data-variant and styles with data-[variant=label|legend]: legend | label.

components.name: FileCard
components.description: Compact file presentation for grids and lists (Drive, Mail attachments, Tasks, Pay invoices).

size.note: The file's byte size, rendered as content. The name collides with the axis vocabulary; there is no size axis.

components.name: FileTypeIcon
components.description: Monochrome file-type icon (Drive, Mail attachments, Tasks, Chat).

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: Upload files by dropping or browsing: a `Dropzone`, with `FileList` and `FileUploadItem` to show each file's progress, status and errors.

components.name: FilterBar
components.description: The filter bar above a table or list: search, saved views, active filters as editable chips, an "Add filter" builder, Clear all, and a slot for trailing table actions.

components.name: FloatingWindow
components.description: A draggable, non-modal floating panel (`role=dialog`, `aria-modal=false`) — for help overlays, detachable widgets, and in-context tools.

components.name: FocusTrap
components.description: Component wrapper around `useFocusTrap`.

components.name: Form
components.description: Form is a deliberately library-agnostic wrapper: a styled `<form>` with sensible vertical rhythm, plus `FormActions` for the footer button row.

components.name: Highlight
components.description: Wraps matched substrings of `children` in `<mark>` — for search-result emphasis.

components.name: HoverCard
components.description: Rich preview shown on hover/focus of a trigger (user cards, entity previews).

components.name: Icon
components.description: Icon standardises `@qeetrix/icons` (and brand) icons onto the Qeetrix size/stroke scale.

size.note: A pixel value, either a number or a key into the ICON_SIZE table that resolves to one.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Icon-only button that enforces an accessible label at the TypeScript level.

size.note: Passed straight to Button's size, restricted to the icon sizes: icon-xs | icon-sm | icon | icon-lg.

components.name: Input
components.description: The Qeet text field.

components.name: InputGroup
components.description: InputGroup composes a text input with leading/trailing addons — a search icon, a currency symbol or unit, a fixed prefix (`https://`), or an action button.

variant.note: InputGroupAddon writes data-variant: inline (on the field surface) | segment (a divided, tinted cell).

components.name: JSONTree
components.description: JSONTree renders any JSON-serialisable value as a collapsible indented tree.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: A keyboard key cap — one key of a shortcut hint.

components.name: Label
components.description: Names a form control.

components.name: Link
components.description: A navigational text link.

components.name: Listbox
components.description: Standalone listbox primitive (APG Listbox) — single or multi-select with roving `aria-activedescendant`.

components.name: LogoUploader
components.description: LogoUploader is a drop-zone + URL fallback for picking a brand logo.

components.name: Marquee
components.description: Continuous scrolling ticker — logo walls, status tickers.

components.name: MaskInput
components.description: `MaskInput` — a single `<Input>` element that formats user input according to a declarative mask string.

components.name: MasterDetail
components.description: Responsive list + detail layout: a resizable two-pane split on wide screens, and a list with the detail in a slide-over `Sheet` below `collapseBelow` (Mail, Contacts, Tasks, Logs, People directories, payment ledgers).

components.name: MentionInput
components.description: Textarea with `@`-mention typeahead.

components.name: Menubar
components.description: App menu bar: a horizontal row of menus (File, Edit, View, …).

variant.note: MenubarItem writes data-variant and styles with data-[variant=destructive]: default | destructive.

exceptions.semantic: Base UI renders an aria-owns bridge span as a direct child of the role=menubar element while a menu is open, so the menubar owns a generic child and axe's aria-required-children fails. No supported workaround in @base-ui/react 1.7.0: Menu.Positioner throws without Menu.Portal, the bridge is only emitted for non-modal focus managers and Menu.Popup hard-codes modal: isContextMenu, and a role="none" wrapper does not help because axe recurses through presentational wrappers. Asserted in composites.test.tsx and subtracted from a whole-widget axe run in menubar.test.tsx, so a Base UI fix surfaces as a failure.

components.name: Meter
components.description: A quota / usage gauge — like Progress, but semantically a measurement within a known range (storage used, seats consumed).

components.name: NativeSelect
components.description: The platform `<select>`, drawn to match `SelectTrigger` — the same field recipe (`fieldTrigger`), the same chevron at the same inset — so the native and the custom select can sit in one form.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.description: Top navigation / mega-menu.

components.name: Notification
components.description: Inline notification card (icon + title + description + close + action), suited for a notification list/feed.

components.name: NotificationCenter
components.description: In-app notification inbox: a bell trigger with an unread badge opening a feed of notifications (all / unread tabs, mark-all-read, per-item dismiss).

components.name: NotificationPreferenceMatrix
components.description: Channel × category notification preferences — a grid of switches (or checkboxes).

components.name: NumberField
components.description: A numeric input with stepper buttons, scrubbing and locale-aware formatting, such as currency.

exceptions.semantic: Base UI renders a text input with aria-roledescription ("Number field") rather than role=spinbutton; the spinbutton keyboard contract (ArrowUp/ArrowDown step) holds. The role description comes from the catalogue (numberField.roleDescription).

components.name: NumberFormatter
components.description: Display-only, locale-aware number formatter (wraps `Intl.NumberFormat`).

components.name: OrgChart
components.description: Top-down organisation / hierarchy chart with collapsible branches (CSS connectors).

components.name: OTPInput
components.description: OTPInput renders `length` single-digit boxes used for entering MFA codes (TOTP, email OTP, SMS OTP).

components.name: OverflowList
components.description: Renders as many items as fit on one line and collapses the rest into a "+N more" trigger.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: The standard top-of-page title block: optional breadcrumb eyebrow, a title, a description, a metadata row and trailing actions.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Pagination is the cursor-based pagination footer used by every index screen — a "First page" jump, a "Next" advance, and a centered label describing the current page.

components.name: PaginationBar
components.description: The former name of `Pagination`, kept as an alias.

deprecation.reason: Renamed to Pagination when the pagination API was consolidated in 1.0.0.
deprecation.migration: Import { Pagination } from "@qeetrix/ui" and rename PaginationBarProps to PaginationProps.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.description: A password field with a reveal toggle.

components.name: PasswordStrengthMeter
components.description: PasswordStrengthMeter renders a 4-segment bar that fills from the inline start with the password's score, plus a textual label and optional caller-supplied feedback strings.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, for content or controls that don't need a full dialog.

components.name: Portal
components.description: Renders its children into `document.body` or another container, mounting on the client only, so overlays escape clipping and stacking contexts.

components.name: PresenceIndicator
components.description: A presence/status mark (online · away · busy · offline) for avatars and rows.

components.name: PreviewCard
components.description: A card that previews a link's destination when the link is hovered or focused.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Task progress (`role="progressbar"`).

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.description: Circular progress (`role="progressbar"`).

components.name: QRCode
components.description: QRCode renders a QR code as an inline SVG, encoded synchronously from `value` with the `qrcode` library's matrix encoder.

size.note: The rendered edge length in pixels, passed to the QR encoder. Not a closed set.

components.name: RadioCard
components.description: A radio with room for a title and a description.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: A set of mutually exclusive options.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Star (or custom icon) rating.

size.note: Indexes the sizeClasses table to size the icon: sm | default | lg.

components.name: ReactionBar
components.description: Inline reactions with a "+" picker, for comments, approvals and activity feeds.

components.name: Resizable
components.description: Panels separated by draggable handles, built from `ResizablePanelGroup`, `ResizablePanel` and `ResizableHandle`.

components.name: RichTextEditor
components.description: WYSIWYG rich-text editor built on Tiptap (StarterKit) with a `Toggle`-based toolbar.

components.name: RollingNumber
components.description: Animates numeric value changes with an eased count-up/down — a KPI tile, a running total.

components.name: ScheduleCalendar
components.description: ScheduleCalendar is a day/week/month agenda surface.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: A scroll container with Qeet scrollbars.

components.name: SecurityItem
components.description: Product-neutral security-resource row for sessions, devices, credentials, passkeys, integrations, and API keys.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: Inline single-select control with an animated sliding indicator.

components.name: Select
components.description: Wraps Base UI's `Select.Root`, auto-deriving the `items` label map from the declared `<SelectItem>`s so the closed trigger shows the option's label rather than its raw value.

size.note: SelectTrigger writes data-size and styles with data-[size=sm] utilities: default | sm.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A 1px rule with `role="separator"` and `aria-orientation`.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, a physical side or the reading direction's start or end, for details, filters or forms.

exceptions.focus: Focus containment is enforced with `inert`, which jsdom does not implement, so the tests assert the mechanism is installed rather than observing containment. Browser-level verification is on the manual checklist.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: The navigation rail itself.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A loading placeholder block.

components.name: SkipNav
components.description: First focusable element on the page — satisfies WCAG 2.4.1 (bypass blocks).

components.name: Slider
components.description: Qeet slider.

exceptions.focus: Base UI hides the thumb until it has measured the track; jsdom has no layout, so the thumb's range input stays out of the computed accessibility tree and focus cannot be observed. Verified structurally instead; browser-level check is on the manual checklist.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate busy indicator.

components.name: Spoiler
components.description: Truncates content to `maxLines` with an inline show-more/less toggle (Disclosure).

components.name: Stat
components.description: Stat (a.k.a. metric card) is the KPI tile for dashboards: a label, a large value, an optional trend delta, an optional hint, and an optional footer (`children`) for a `Sparkline` or a link.

components.name: StatusPill
components.description: StatusPill is a thin wrapper over Badge that centralises the status-to-colour mapping (active = green, expired = red, etc.).

kind.note: Mapped through KIND_TO_BADGE onto Badge's variant, so Badge's cva is the definition. `kind` is also a VARIANT_GROUP_ALIASES synonym for `variant`.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Step indicator for multi-step flows (onboarding, checkout, provisioning).

orientation.note: Structural: horizontal | vertical, written to data-orientation. Not an appearance axis.

components.name: Switch
components.description: An on/off control.

size.note: Written to data-size and styled with data-[size=sm] utilities: default | sm.

components.name: Table
components.description: The parts of a semantic table (header, body, rows and cells) in Qeetrix styling, with a scrolling container and an optional sticky header.

components.name: TableOfContents
components.description: Scroll-spy table of contents (navigation landmark).

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switches between panels of related content in one place, in the contained default style or the `line` style for page navigation.

components.name: TagInput
components.description: Free-form chips input: type and press Enter (or comma) to add a tag, Backspace on an empty field to remove the last one.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text field on the shared field recipe.

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: Time-of-day picker built from `Select` columns (hours / minutes / optional seconds / AM-PM).

components.name: TimeRangePicker
components.description: Preset + custom time-range selector (log windows, analytics, billing periods).

components.name: TimeSince
components.description: TimeSince renders a relative-time label ("5 minutes ago", "1 day ago") with a hover tooltip showing the absolute locale-formatted timestamp.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Vertical event/audit history.

tone.note: TimelineIndicator writes data-tone: neutral | brand | info | success | warning | destructive (danger is a legacy alias).

components.name: Timer
components.description: A countdown or stopwatch readout with optional Start/Pause/Resume and Reset controls.

components.name: TimezonePicker
components.description: TimezonePicker: every IANA zone from `Intl.supportedValuesOf("timeZone")`, each with its current offset ("GMT+5:30") and, where it adds something, its localised name ("India Standard Time").

components.name: Toast
components.description: Brief notifications: mount `Toaster` once and call `toast()` from anywhere; toasts stack, pause on hover and announce politely.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A two-state button.

components.name: ToggleTip
components.description: A small button that shows a hint in a popover when pressed, so the hint also works on touch screens and from the keyboard.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Action bar for tables, editors, and detail views — buttons, links, separators.

variant.note: Toolbar.variant (default | ghost) is a container data-attribute; ToolbarButton.variant and ToolbarLink are forwarded to Button's buttonVariants.

size.note: ToolbarButton/ToolbarLink size is passed straight to buttonVariants: default | sm | icon | icon-sm and the rest of Button's scale.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short label that appears on hover or keyboard focus to name or describe a control.

components.name: Tour
components.description: Step-by-step guided product onboarding overlay.

components.name: TreeView
components.description: Hierarchical disclosure tree (file trees, nested log scopes, org units).

components.name: Typography
components.description: Consistent text styling for discrete pieces of copy — headings, lead/body paragraphs, blockquotes, inline code, lists, and muted/small captions.

components.name: VisuallyHidden
components.description: Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers.
